title: rclone before 1.76.0 leaks credentials in its swift, netstorage and seafile backends, which follow HTTP redirects…
description: rclone versions before 1.76.0 have a vulnerability in the swift, netstorage, and seafile backends where credentials can be leaked due to following HTTP redirects with Go's default policy. This causes authentication headers, passwords, or API tokens to be sent on redirects that downgrade from HTTPS to HTTP or cross-host redirects, potentially exposing sensitive credentials to attackers who can observe or receive these redirects.
